ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is t, and the vertical axis is f(t). The waveform is 0 before t=-1; starting from t=-1, an exponentially decaying curve appears, with amplitude 1 at t=-1, and it gradually decays to the right as t increases. The signal is also labeled in the figure as e^{-(t+1)}u(t+1). Reasoning: According to the method given in the problem, regard the 1 in the convolution as a constant signal identically equal to 1. From the image, f(t)=e^{-(t+1)}u(t+1) can be obtained, so f(τ) is nonzero only when τ≥-1. The convolution is (1*f)(t)=∫_{-∞}^{∞}1·f(τ)dτ=∫_{-1}^{∞}e^{-(τ+1)}dτ. Let x=τ+1, then the integral becomes ∫_0^{∞}e^{-x}dx=1. Therefore, the convolution result is the constant 1.

推理：按照题设方法，将卷积中的 1 看作恒等于 1 的常值信号。由图像可得 f(t)=e^{-(t+1)}u(t+1)，因此 f(τ) 只在 τ≥-1 时非零。卷积为 (1*f)(t)=∫_{-∞}^{∞}1·f(τ)dτ=∫_{-1}^{∞}e^{-(τ+1)}dτ。令 x=τ+1，则积分变为 ∫_0^{∞}e^{-x}dx=1。所以卷积结果为常数 1。

method.method_draft: From the image, write f(t)=e^{-(t+1)}u(t+1). Move to the Fourier-transform domain: 1 ↔ 2πδ(ω). Since time convolution becomes frequency multiplication, 1*f(t) has transform 2πδ(ω)F(ω). Evaluate the multiplier at DC: F(0), the area of the shifted exponential, equals 1. Thus the product is 2πδ(ω), whose inverse transform is the constant signal 1.

推理：按指定方法转到傅里叶变换域。常数信号 1 的傅里叶变换为 2πδ(ω)。时间卷积对应频域相乘，所以 1*f(t) 的频域表达为 2πδ(ω)F(ω)。由于 δ(ω) 只取直流处的值，F(ω)δ(ω)=F(0)δ(ω)。这里 F(0) 等于 f(t) 的面积：∫_{-1}^{∞} e^{-(t+1)}dt=∫_0^{∞}e^{-x}dx=1。因此频域结果为 2πδ(ω)，其反变换就是常数信号 1。
